preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**6 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value ai is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The list a contains exactly n integers, one for each vertex.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges form a tree with n-1 undirected edges, where each edge connects two distinct vertices in the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(max(a[x] for x in path) - min(a[x] for x in path) for x, y in edges for path in get_all_paths_between(x, y)))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of I(x, y) = (max(a_i) - min(a_i)) for all edges (x, y) in the tree, where the path between x and y is considered, and a_i are the vertex values on that path.
